name: SIQ - Top Info Bar
description: A sleek 3-column top bar displayed above the header. Left column shows clickable social media icons (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, X/Twitter, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Snapchat). Center column shows a rotating announcement text with optional link and autoplay. Right column provides a locale switcher for language and/or currency. Fully configurable: colors, bar height, font size, icon size, dividers, number of social icons, and which locale controls to show. Hides gracefully on mobile with configurable behavior.
author: SectionIQ
